headline.text: US central bank signals more interest rate rises
headline.context: Almost all Fed officials see further hikes as likely.
headline.vo: The US Federal Reserve is signalling more interest rate rises. Minutes from its October meeting, released on Wednesday, show almost all officials expect further increases.

beats.label: top of the Fed's key rate range, held in October
beats.vo: In October, the Fed kept its key rate between three point seven five and four percent. The vote was ten to two, and some officials called it a close call. Inflation has stayed higher than the Fed wants.

beats.title: How we got here
beats.vo: In September, the Fed raised its key rate. In October, it held rates in a split vote. On Wednesday, the minutes pointed to more rises. The next decision is due in December.

text: Gold fell about *3%* to a one-year low
beats.vo: Gold fell about three percent on Wednesday to its lowest level in more than a year, Reuters reports. Officials also flagged price risks from spending on artificial intelligence. Higher rates make loans and mortgages more expensive.

title: US Federal Reserve signals more interest rate rises as gold falls to a one-year low
caption: Minutes from the US Federal Reserve's October meeting show almost all officials expect further interest rate rises, after the Fed held its key rate at 3.75% to 4% in a 10 to 2 vote. Gold fell about 3% on Wednesday to its lowest level in more than a year. The Fed's next rate decision is due in December, and higher rates would make loans and mortgages more expensive.
